# Værksted

> Værksted (Danish for "workshop") is an EU-registered studio that builds AI-native products and advises organizations on becoming AI-native. Privacy by default, no data brokerage, simplicity, and design measured by how it works. Based in København (Copenhagen), Denmark; established MMXXVI (2026).

Værksted does two things: we build a family of AI-native products, and we advise organizations that want to become AI-native. Advice and plans only: we do not build or run systems for clients. We make money by selling software, not by selling our users — no ads, no trackers, no data brokerage, no lock-in. We aim to run a reasonable company and build technology that leaves people better off.

## Cases

- [Cases: Maskin and Skjald](https://vaerksted.ai/cases/): Maskin and Skjald: what each product is and where it stands, as confirmed by its owner.
- [Maskin case: an open source AI agent workspace](https://vaerksted.ai/cases/maskin/): Maskin is an open-source (Apache-2.0) AI agent workspace where people and agents work on the same typed objects. Early-stage, with a hosted version.
- [Skjald case: a meeting notetaker built by Værksted](https://vaerksted.ai/cases/skjald/): Skjald records, transcribes and writes up what was decided, who does what and who spoke. On your own device by default. Pre-release, not on the App Store yet.

## Principles

- **Privacy by default**: Your work is yours. We don't sell it.
- **We sell software, not you**: Our money comes from people buying our products, not from selling access to you. No ads, no trackers, no data brokerage.
- **Simplicity over surface area**: One craft, done well. If a feature doesn't earn its place, it doesn't ship.
- **Design is how it works**: Looks matter. Craft matters more — the interface, the latency, the recovery from failure.
- **No addictive patterns**: No infinite scrolls, no manipulated streaks, no engagement metrics dressed up as care. Tools you can put down.
- **No lock-in**: Your data is yours, in formats you can read. Leave whenever you want.

## Products

- [Maskin](https://maskin.io): The machine. An open-source (Apache-2.0) workspace where people and AI agents work on the same typed objects: insights, bets, tasks and knowledge. Early-stage, in active development, with a hosted version.
- Skjald: The bard. A meeting notetaker that records, transcribes and writes up what was decided, who does what and who spoke. Pre-release, for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Not on the App Store yet.
- Saga: The storyteller. A text editor for long-form writing — where ideas become narratives that hold together.
- [Sindre](https://sindre.ai): The smith. A product management agent that turns intent into shipped work.
- Hugin: The raven. A shared inbox that brings every social channel into one place. In development ("in the forge").
- [Rask](https://syntheticpractitioner.com): The mender. In development ("in the forge"); waitlist open.

## The builders

- [Sebastian Krumhausen](https://skrumhausen.com): CPO, founder, investor. His master's thesis at LEGO Future Lab became LEGO Life (launched 2017, 8M+ active users). Product leadership at momondo, KAYAK, TELUS, and Trackunit. Trained 250+ product managers in AI, lean, and agile.
- Magnus Nøddegaard Hansen: Engineer and builder since 17. Designed and built Maskin's MCP-native architecture from scratch. Thinks in systems, ships in weeks.
